item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli military strikes have destroyed a building in Gaza and killed a child on the cease‑fire anniversary, while the Hamas‑run health ministry reports 1,488 Palestinians killed since the cease‑fire began. A flydubai co‑pilot planned a suicide attack on an Israeli airport, according to prosecutors. Demonstrations continue across Europe, with large rallies in London and protests in Berlin demanding an end to the war. Activists are urging a global medical body to suspend Israeli association over the Gaza genocide. The conflict caused 21,440 battle‑related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
